summary_en: AViC announces a change in dividend policy, establishing a target DOE of 2% with annual year-end dividends and a progressive dividend principle. The company will pay its first dividend of 12 yen per share for the fiscal year ending September 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy and Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending September 2027 (Initial Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
AViC announced on November 13, 2026, a change in its dividend policy and the initiation of dividend payments. The company, which had previously prioritized internal reserves and paid no dividends, will adopt a new approach centered on year-end dividends with a target dividend on equity (DOE) of 2% annually, coupled with a progressive dividend policy of maintaining or increasing dividends without reduction in principle. This policy will apply from the fiscal year ending September 2027 onward.

The company will pay its first dividend of 12 yen per share for the fiscal year ending September 2027. The policy change reflects strong financial performance, with consolidated revenue and net income attributable to parent company shareholders increasing 51.7% and 38.1% respectively in the fiscal year ending September 2026, alongside the consolidation of Spica as a subsidiary in January 2026. The company determined that its financial foundation, including a self-capital ratio of 52.4%, coupled with necessary capital for future growth investments, enables profitable shareholder return distribution while maintaining adequate capacity for strategic growth investments.
